_comment: Declared outbound network destinations for the FaceAuth runtime.
Every entry here is a destination this project is KNOWN to contact and has
explicitly accepted for now. An entry is not an endorsement - it is a
record that the behaviour was investigated, written up, and consciously
scripts/check_network_activity.py fails if the runtime contacts anything
NOT listed here. Adding an entry is a deliberate act that requires the same
investigation the existing entry got: destination, trigger, transmitted
data, and whether it can be turned off.
The goal is for this list to become EMPTY. Phase 3 requires it (blocker
B17): the verifier service is specified with no network access at all.
'allow_empty_for_phase3' is the assertion that must eventually hold.

allowed.source: mediapipe (bundled libmediapipe.dll, Google Clearcut telemetry client)
allowed.trigger: MediaPipe task session teardown (close()); fires even with zero detect() calls
allowed.transmits: per the extracted MediaPipe telemetry extension schema: platform, host environment, mediapipe version, app_id, solution name, graph name, init latency, invocation counts. That schema has no field for an image, frame, landmark, embedding, or template. The surrounding Clearcut envelope was not decrypted; see docs/PRIVACY_NETWORK_AUDIT.md section 1.3.
allowed.opt_out: none - upstream explicitly declined to add one (google-ai-edge/mediapipe#6291, closed 2026-07-06)
